parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular and the QRS is narrow, with very deep S waves in V1-V3 (about 50 mm in V2) and tall R waves in V6 (about 18 mm). V6 also shows ST depression with T inversion (strain pattern), and the ST elevation in V1-V3 is the expected discordant change after deep S waves, not an acute STEMI.
